title: access.grants.sections props, contract version 1
description: The props of the sections of the grants page, a slot point in its sections region (PRD 5.10, 13.4): none. The grants are the page's own, read as the person, and a section's data query reads what it needs as the viewer. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\Access\Domain\Dto\AccessGrantsSectionsV1.
